title: Reading Platform
highlight: Cut initial page load by ~40% and improved perceived performance by pairing React Context with skeleton loading states.

description.name: Architecture & Security
description.text: Built a literacy platform using Next.js, Express.js, and MongoDB featuring secure authentication (JWT via httpOnly cookies), capable to refresh token silently and provide skeleton loading to improve perceived performance.

description.name: Core Platform Features
description.text: Full CRUD on written works, with ownership-based edit/delete access, Bookmarking with optimistic UI updates, Star ratings, and Cover image and PDF attachment uploads that is connected to a Cloudflare R2 bucket.
